model_output:
```sql
WITH nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT 
    park_name,
    geometry
  FROM 
    parks
  WHERE 
    leisure IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE 'New Kent County' AND border_type ILIKE 'county'))
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve ORDER BY park_name LIMIT 1), TRUE) AS rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve ORDER BY park_name LIMIT 1))
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT park_name FROM nature_reserve ORDER BY park_name LIMIT 1) AS reserve_name,
  MAX((ST_Value(rast, 1))::numeric) AS max_elevation
FROM 
  clipped_dem;
```
